items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: The tenor player with Fats Domino, Tall Collies.

ctx.x: Do you know how to spell his last name? I think it was P-I-R-S, Paris. Well, we can check with the local. Yeah.

And his wife is here. Oh. Yeah, I think his wife is here. He told me she's still staying here in New Orleans. Because he left her here years ago. We did some recording. We did a couple of sessions and Joe's got on one number on that. I was featured on it during Willow Weep for Me. And the other side of it, we call it Mop Mop Brown. It was the changes to Sweet Georgia Brown. And we used those changes, but our whole melody and call it Mop Mop Brown. It's Joe Parrish by South On Bass. And I think Freddie Coleman's…
Oh, it'll come to me. Yeah, I think he's still with Fats. Yeah, he probably is. Yes.
